title: Before I Could Walk
style: anthemic rock, 108 BPM, building verse to massive chorus, WA identity anthem, survivor energy, pride in resilience, male vocal NZ/AU accent raw and confident, driving guitars, open chorus, original sound, V4_5ALL
lyrics:
[VERSE 1]
They found me up a tree
Before I could walk they say
I don't know what that means
Except I was always going somewhere

Bronchitis then asthma
Then nothing — resolved
The body decides its own timeline
Problems that themselves dissolved

[PRE-CHORUS]
NZ roots in WA ground
Indian Ocean — family sound
Swan River in the chest
West coast — always west

[CHORUS]
Before I could walk — I climbed
Before I knew fear — I survived
Before I knew what this place was
I was already alive

[VERSE 2]
Pete on the water
Mum at the hospital door
Dad from the other island
All of us on this shore

WA isn't borrowed culture
WA is where we earned
The coastline isn't backdrop
It's the thing that we learned

[BRIDGE]
Every near thing.
Every close call.
Every time I almost wasn't here —
Is why I'm still going.

[FINAL CHORUS — huge]
Before I could walk — I climbed
Before I knew fear — I survived
Before I knew what ZYNTHIO was
I was already alive

[OUTRO]
Western Australia.
Earned.
Not borrowed.
Earned.
